# T01: Build BottomSheet and AccessibleToggle components

**Created BottomSheet (pan gesture + 3 snap points), BottomSheetHandle, and AccessibleToggle (iOS-style spring switch) — all using useTheme() from S01.**

## What Happened

Created the structural UI chrome components defined in the S02 plan:

1. **`BottomSheet.tsx`** — Gesture-driven bottom sheet using `GestureDetector` + `Gesture.Pan()` from react-native-gesture-handler. Three snap points at heights `[120, 300, 600]` px (collapsed / half / full). Spring-animated snap with `withSpring(damping: 50, stiffness: 300)`. Calls `onSnapChange(index: 0|1|2)` callback on settle. Fixed invalid `accessibilityRole="dialog"` to plain `accessibilityLabel`.

2. **`BottomSheetHandle.tsx`** — Visual grip bar (40×4px rounded rectangle) and optional text label, themed with `useTheme()`.

3. **`AccessibleToggle.tsx`** — iOS-standard 51×31px track with 27px spring-animated knob (`withSpring(damping: 20, stiffness: 400, mass: 0.6)`). Full ARIA roles: `accessibilityRole="switch"`, `accessibilityState={{ checked, disabled }}`, label, and hint. Disabled state dims to 40% opacity.

4. **`sheet/index.ts`** — Barrel export for sheet components.

5. **`settings/index.ts`** — Barrel export for settings components.

## Verification

TypeScript typecheck: `cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -E "components/sheet|components/settings"` → **0 errors** in new files. All pre-existing TS errors in App.tsx and other files are unrelated to this task.

## Verification Evidence

| # | Command | Exit Code | Verdict | Duration |
|---|---------|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | `cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 \| grep -E "components/sheet\|components/settings"` | 1 | ✅ pass (0 errors in new components) | ~15s |

## Diagnostics

All components use `useTheme()` and will automatically adapt to light/dark mode as the system preference changes. The BottomSheet's `sheetY` position is measured from the top of the screen (always `SCREEN_HEIGHT - snapPointHeight`) so the sheet's height always fills the full screen regardless of snap point.

## Deviations

None.

## Known Issues

None.
